dialogue: After a [color=#f8c868]slide boost[/color], you can keep speed by [color=#f8c868]sliding[/color] when you land!
Then when sliding, jump and [color=#f8c868]boost again[/color]!
You can chain slide boosts to build speed and zip through bushes!
Just don’t get reckless with it, or you might hit something and lose your speed.
If you can cross the gaps above you find an area thats perfect for practicing!
